copy.tagline_en: Load backend development standards to improve code quality and security

howto.what: Claude 会遵循后端开发标准，包括错误处理、依赖注入、结构化日志、安全配置、输入验证和自动化质量检查。
howto.when: 当你在编写后端代码时，Claude 会自动加载此技能，并可能调用语言检测和环境变量工具来加载相关技能。

say.text: 帮我写一个安全的数据库查询函数。
say.note: Claude 会使用参数化查询并验证输入。

say.text: 检查这段代码的错误处理是否符合标准。
say.note: Claude 会检查是否显式返回错误并包含上下文。

howto.what_en: Claude will follow backend development standards including error handling, dependency injection, structured logging, security configuration, input validation, and automated quality checks.
howto.when_en: When you are writing backend code, Claude will automatically load this skill and may call language detection and environment variable tools to load related skills.

say_en.text: Write a secure database query function.
say_en.note: Claude will use parameterized queries and validate inputs.

say_en.text: Check if this code's error handling meets standards.
say_en.note: Claude will check for explicit error returns with context.
